messages:
Alice Chen: Heads-up: bug-bounty #BB-382 reported a container escape PoC against our onprem runtime v1.8.2. Attacker uses a privileged mount + setns sequence to breakout to the host. PoC link: https://h1.example/BB-382 :eyes:
Ben Ortiz: Confirmed repro on v1.8.2 in a minimal cluster. Repro steps saved in the ticket. Short mitigation: block privileged containers and deny hostPath mounts, cordon the effected nodes ASAP.
Dmitri Kovalenko: I cordoned node-17 and put it into isolation network ACL (egress DENY except registry + kms-proxy). Created INC-2026-03-21-17.
sec-bot: Incident created INC-2026-03-21-17 by Dmitri Kovalenko. Priority: P1.
Eva Morales: Important: we need strong audit evidence for customers. Do we have attestation artifacts (TPM quote / signed measurement) for node-17 at the time of the exploit? If not, we must capture whatever we can and add attestation to the audit schema.
Carol Ng: Filing a small schema change to include attestation blobs and image signature metadata in audit logs. Draft PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/prs/621 — will include tooling to verify locally for air-gapped installs.
Ben Ortiz: Quick networkpolicy we pushed to clusters (applies to runtime-namespace) — adds egress allow to kms-proxy and registry only, denyAll otherwise:
```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: runtime-egress-lockdown
  namespace: redwood-runtime
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/22   # internal registry
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```
Ben Ortiz: Also removed CAP_SYS_ADMIN, CAP_SYS_PTRACE and restricted hostPath mounts clusterwide for runtime pods.
Alice Chen: For audit logs we need a compact field that ties an operation to an attestation proof. Proposed log snippet for every node-level critical event:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-21T17:12:04Z","node_id":"node-17","event":"container.exec","user":"svc-runtime","image_sig":"sha256:abcd...","attestation_jwt":"eyJhbGciOiJI...","attestor_id":"onprem-tpm-01"}
```
Alice Chen: We must ensure the attestation_jwt is stored in immutable audit retention (90 days for onprem customers by default, configurable).
Dmitri Kovalenko: Recovery steps we executed: cordon -> snapshot node logs to S3 archived path -> rotate KMS proxy token -> replace runtime pods with non-privileged images -> run image signature verification across cluster. Rotation command (kms-proxy):
```
./kms-proxy rotate-token --scope=runtime --force
```
Dmitri Kovalenko: PR to add new RBAC roles: `attestation.viewer` and `attestation.verifier` + limit `attestation.create` to ops. See https://git.internal/r/redwood/rbac/changes/137.
Eva Morales: For air-gapped customers we need an offline verification flow: customers can upload a signed TPM quote and image signatures to our compliance endpoint; verifier returns a signed attestation blob they can store locally. Add that to KB.
Carol Ng: I'll draft a KB and a small CLI `attest-check` that validates the chain-of-trust locally (TPM quote -> image signature -> signed attestation blob). Will post draft by EOD.
Alice Chen: Action items: 1) Keep node-17 isolated until full forensic (Dmitri). 2) Push networkpolicy and capability restrictions clusterwide (Ben). 3) Schema + retention PR (Carol). 4) RBAC PR review and rollout window (everyone). 5) Customer comms + KB for offline attestation (Eva/Carol). @Ben @Dmitri @Eva please ack and post short status updates here. :thumbsup:
